x.description: Ten-thousandths of the image width from the left.

y.description: Ten-thousandths of the image height from the top.

text.description: Note text, one entry per language.

subject.description: AT URI of the page, slice or strip.

main.description: A note pinned to a point on comic artwork.

description: A creator note pinned to a point on a page, slice or strip; a copy of the work.sequential.feed.annotation of the same record key.
